purpose: Repair reproducible implementation and solver limitations, then measure all fixed development tasks without changing the benchmark or archived formal observations.

inputs.selection: All registered cases, including invalid inputs and frontend failures

lgcs.problem: Same perspective graph-of-convex-sets mixed-integer shortest-path problem
lgcs.fallback: None; save primal bound, dual bound, gap and exact termination status

nto_refined.refinement_rule: Add the minimum-clearance time in each detected low-clearance interval; no per-case tuning
nto_refined.control_points: Retain original NTO_PAPER initialization and spline order

comparison.reference_role: Paired engineering comparison; historical and new source protocols are never pooled into one method score
comparison.metrics: Existing independent validator and BASELINE_PROTOCOL.md definitions; scene-cluster intervals and matched common-success costs

invariants: Canonical robot, collision filters, obstacle geometry, voxel radii and endpoints remain unchanged
Every success requires the unchanged independent numerical validator
All failed diagnostic attempts, original profiles and frozen formal results are retained
Source snapshots and resolved configurations are captured before each batch
No per-task choice of optimizer, margin, endpoint, model or best result
